opportunities.title: Main Grants

amount.raw: Up to £500,000 for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in our Strategic Review.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Proposals must address one or more of the priority questions outlined in the Strategic Review. Must be led by individuals with formal employment or contractual relationship with the institution hosting the grant for at least the duration of the project.
opportunities.summary: Rapid response research funding to understand the economic and social impacts on the UK of the 2026 conflict involving US, Iran, Israel and the wider region.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research proposals on racial diversity within the UK. Must focus on or incorporate themes of racial inequalities, discrimination, and pathways to racial justice.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on racial inequalities, discrimination, and pathways to racial justice.

opportunities.title: Strategic Fund

amount.raw: Up to £15 million available, grants typically in the range of £1-3 million each.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Proposals must address one or more of the five priority questions set out in the Strategic Review. Must be led by individuals with formal employment or contractual relationship with the institution hosting the grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports new, transformative ideas that address significant themes and developments shaping the UK public policy agenda.

opportunities.title: UK impacts of the US-Iran conflict

amount.raw: Up to eight projects, with a total funding budget of up to £300,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications from UK-based organisations, including universities, research institutes, think tanks, policy institutes, and research consultancies.
opportunities.summary: Rapid response research funding to understand the economic and social impacts on the UK of the 2026 conflict involving US, Iran, Israel and the wider region.
